# Weighted average truck battery pack size and cost, 2020-2024 

Last updated 7 Apr 2025

###### Sources

IEA analysis based on data from Bloomberg New Energy Finance and EV Volumes .

###### Notes

MD = medium-duty; HD = heavy-duty. Trucks refers to medium- and heavy-duty freight trucks. Battery pack cost is calculated as the sales-weighted battery pack price per kWh for commercial vehicles multiplied by the sales-weighted battery pack size for the vehicle segment.
